answer_1.quote: We use GPT-4o to generate a document-level synthetic parallel corpus by forward-translating English Europarl into seven diverse low-resource languages.
answer_1.outputs: synthetic parallel translations (English‑target language sentence pairs)

answer_2.quote: we compute two neural metrics at the segment level: Bicleaner‑AI and COMETKiwi... We report ChrF as our main automatic metric, as it has been the standard metric for low‑resource MT... We also evaluate GPT‑4o on the full FLORES+ test set and include it as a reference in our results.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation for five languages... Each language pair was scored by 1-3 annotators. Following the Direct Assessment (DA) protocol... Annotators were shown the source sentence and its translation, and were asked to assign a score on a 0‑100 scale.
answer_4.guideline: Direct Assessment protocol: annotators rate translation quality on a 0‑100 scale based on provided guidelines.
